08

Buttons Updated 1 New Variant

Four variants. Primary = Deep Blue. Usage rules are strict — see note below.

Primary — Deep Blue · light backgrounds only
On dark background — white + outline-white only
Accent-edge — segment-aware (New ★)
Disabled — all variants
⚠️ btn-primary (Deep Blue fill) must only be used on white or light backgrounds. On Deep Blue or dark sections, use btn-white or btn-outline-white instead.

09

Icon Box System Updated

Icons always white on colored square. Padding: 16px (all sizes). Border-radius: 4px. Apply filter: brightness(0) invert(1) to the img.

Color variants
--deep-blue
--cropx-blue
--muted-gold
--new-leaf
--terra
Size variants — all with 16px padding
--icon-xs · 16px
--icon-sm · 20px
--icon-md · 24px
--icon-lg · 32px
--icon-xl · 48px

10

Hero Emphasis Underline Updated

Two thickness levels. 6px bold for hero H1 and pre-footer CTA only. 3px refined everywhere else.

6px — Hero H1 + pre-footer CTA only

Make every irrigation decision count

3px — All other emphasis underlines

Reduce water use by up to 40%

13

Segment Background New

Deep Blue section with hero-pattern.svg animation (Option A — slow drift, masked left). Segment name uses --fs-segment-name: 2rem.

CropX Platform

Enterprise Solutions

Real-time visibility into field conditions across hundreds of farms. Seamless equipment integration and enterprise-grade traceability tools included.

14

Logo Strip New

Animated marquee — hover to pause. Three color treatments. Height: 30px · Gap: 3rem · Fade: 3.5rem · Duration: 35s.

Greyscale — on white background
White — on deep blue background

15

Content Tags New

Two variants — Deep Blue on light backgrounds, White on Deep Blue backgrounds. Same logic as the button system.

On white / light backgrounds — --tag-bg + --tag-text
